I'm going to pivot. Instead of searching for the tools themselves, I will search for **"best offensive security GitHub repositories"** and **"curated lists of red teaming tools GitHub"**. These broader, intent-based queries should yield the "Awesome" lists and security collections that aggregate exactly the kind of playbooks we need to study and modify. 

I'm recalibrating my approach now.
